university.name: University of Layyah
university.mission: To provide quality education and research opportunities to students of southern Punjab

process: 1. Check eligibility criteria for desired program
2. Fill out the online application form at uol.edu.pk
5. Appear for merit-based selection or entry test if required
6. Check merit list on the university portal
required_documents: HEC recognized degree equivalency certificate (for foreign qualifications)

eligibility.BS_programs: Minimum 45% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent. Some programs require FSc Pre-Engineering or Pre-Medical.
eligibility.general: Pakistani national with valid matriculation and intermediate certificates

deadlines.note: Check the official website for exact dates each year

admissions.fee_note: Fee structures are updated each academic year. Contact the Accounts Section for current fees.

fee_structure.note: Fees are subject to change. Confirm with the Accounts Section for the latest fee structure.

scholarships.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Pakistani students with financial need, minimum 60% marks
scholarships.how_to_apply: Apply online through HEC scholarship portal

scholarships.name: Prime Minister Fee Reimbursement Scheme
scholarships.eligibility: Students from low-income families enrolled in recognized universities

scholarships.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
scholarships.eligibility: Punjab domicile holders with financial need and good academic record
scholarships.how_to_apply: Apply through PEEF portal at www.peef.org.pk

scholarships.name: University Merit Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students securing top positions in their batch
scholarships.how_to_apply: Automatically awarded based on academic performance

campus_facilities: Sports Complex (Cricket Ground, Football Field, Indoor Sports)

attendance_policy.consequence: Students with less than 75% attendance may be debarred from appearing in final examinations
attendance_policy.medical_leave: Medical leave requires a doctor's certificate submitted to the relevant department within 3 days

examination_rules: Students must carry their University ID card to all examinations
Use of mobile phones is strictly prohibited in examination halls
No student is allowed to enter the examination hall 30 minutes after the start
Students must maintain silence and avoid any form of unfair means
Cheating or any unfair means results in immediate cancellation of the exam and disciplinary action
Coursework/assignments must be submitted by the deadline; late submissions may receive reduced marks
Mid-semester exams are typically held in the 8th-9th week of semester
Final exams are held at the end of the semester
academic_policies: Minimum passing grade: D (GPA 1.0) in most programs
Students must maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.0 to remain in good academic standing
Academic probation for students with CGPA below 2.0
Maximum duration to complete BS degree: 6 years
Credit transfer is allowed from HEC-recognized institutions with department approval
student_conduct: Maintain a respectful and professional environment
Dress code: Formal/semi-formal attire is expected on campus
Students are responsible for the care of university property
Ragging of any form is strictly prohibited and punishable
Smoking is not allowed on campus premises
Students must carry their university identity cards at all times

annual_events: Orientation Week for new students (start of each semester)
events_and_activities.note: Check the university notice board and official website for current event schedules

contact_information.address: University of Layyah, Layyah-Multan Road, Layyah, Punjab, Pakistan
